architecture_b_selection: Minimum validation cross-entropy over epochs 0-50, as in the frozen original CNN trainer
pair_selection: Same fit-only full-map residual MSE times outgoing quaternion-kernel energy as the original internal study; use nested prefixes of four/eight disjoint pairs
scope: Prespecified extension to 4/8 removals and two sequential CNN depths (6 and 8 convolutions), not arbitrary architecture families. Reuse existing CNN6 baselines and mark its four-removal condition as exploratory, not independent replication. Train three CNN8 baselines with the same data/optimizer/epoch budget. Data-weighted projection is an equivalent strong control, not a new algorithm. No official-test inference or compression fine-tuning.
